name: Warm Up Seattle PBQ 2025
information: Welcome to the Pacific Northwest! [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.pnwcubing.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) * [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/39HzT57upV) Warm Up Seattle PBQ 2025 is an exciting event for both attendees of the World Championships 2025 and folks who are not able to attend the championship. This WCA page is for a Friday **PBQ** containing only 4x4 blindfolded, 5x5 blindfolded, and 3x3 Mult-Blind. On Saturday and Sunday, there is also a more traditional favorites-style competition. View more information or register for that competition [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025). By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WarmUpSeattle2025#52996-please-read-competitor-responsibilities-schedule-explanation).
